description: Per-pixel delta shadows smoke (XR-07, XR-08; developer build: -Asi Release\ApexRadiance.asi). Needs the bridge pair of patches 0019-0020 (0022 for variant meshes) and the x64 d3d9.dll of native/dxvk in Bin. Real-Time Lighting on with pixelShadows and the filtered mask view through a 60 s pan. Variant sims: no test capsule, the Sims' own capsules (casters from the Sim draws): the counters line shows sims above 0 and rays above 0. Variant meshes (XR-10): with meshCasters, the server's meshes cast in the pass and the objects it resolved leave the Direct3D 9 lamps' 3D test (darkened once): the On line says meshCasters=1 and the mesh line shows read-backs and meshed records above 0. Variant rigs (XR-10 part 4): with pixelSimRigs, each Sim draw's capsules come from its own skin: the On line says simRigs=1, a first-rig line gives the pelvis's bind place (about 1 m from the model origin for an adult if the bind poses are inverse binds), the counters line shows rigs, paired draws and fitted draws above 0 with rigFaults=0. Variant on (the default): the test capsule. Pass: no crash, the On line, a counters line with passes and rays above 0 and faults=0, no off or error line.

expect: \[GiPixel\] passes=[1-9]\d* .* simDrawsFit=[1-9]\d* rigFills=[1-9]\d* rigs=[1-9]\d* rigFaults=0 simDrawsRig=[1-9]
